totals[0], totals[-1], totals[1:3]

caption: A slice stops before its end position.

code:
c = {"id": 101, "name": "Ada"}
c["name"]              # Ada
c.get("email")         # None
c.get("email", "n/a")  # n/a
c["email"] = "ada@x.com"
caption: Brackets raise KeyError; .get() does not.

eyebrow: A list of dicts is a table
code:
rows = [
    {"name": "Ada", "total": 55.5},
    {"name": "Grace", "total": 8.25},
    {"name": "Linus", "total": 130.0},
]
[r["name"] for r in rows
 if r["total"] > 50]
# ['Ada', 'Linus']
caption: The same shape as JSON from a web API.
